title: MENU-01 public redacted frame construction and presentation microbenchmark
scope: Offline SDK-independent C# BuildFrame plus Present object construction only; no rasterization, native drawing, or RPH/game execution.
authorization: Parent authorized one short quiet measurement window; the fixed nine-process protocol ran once.
boundaries: No GTA launch or installed asset access
No private RPH SDK assembly loading
No endpoint, window, recording, deployment, or merge
No production/test/documentation code changes by this benchmark

workload.status: Static valid CPU balanced/16-path fixture, enabled output=1, early reflections on; constructed before timing
workload.state: Fully open at 260 ms, pre-created before timing

protocol.forcedCollection: GC.Collect / WaitForPendingFinalizers / GC.Collect after warmup, before measured warm batch
protocol.percentiles: Nearest rank over raw samples; median averages the middle pair
protocol.coldScope: First BuildFrame and Present calls including their JIT/static initialization; menu/status/state/harness setup and process launch excluded
protocol.warmScope: Each sample spans BuildFrame, one intervening timestamp read, and Present; output inspection, Sample creation and loop bookkeeping are outside each frame sample, inside whole-batch CPU timing

environment.quietWindow: Root compiler/renderer and other agent static; ordinary OS/background interference was not eliminated

sourceProvenance.lineEndingDistinction: Baseline/imported files were extracted as exact Git blob bytes (LF). Current compiled files preserve working-copy bytes (CRLF). All seven current source/provenance files match imported Git after CRLF-to-LF normalization; raw hashes intentionally differ.
sourceProvenance.bridge: InGameMenu.Rph.cs captured for source provenance only, never compiled or loaded

processRuns.callScope: BuildFrame+Present(7 arguments), pointer visible inside sidebar
BuildFrame+Present(7 arguments), pointer visible inside sidebar
BuildFrame+Present(7 arguments), pointer visible inside sidebar

cpuInterpretation: TotalProcessorTime differences are quantized: observed warm deltas are 0 or 15.625 ms for 1000-frame batches. Zero is below accounting resolution, not zero CPU work. These short batches do not establish a CPU improvement or a precise per-frame CPU charge. Stopwatch wall timings and CPU accounting are separate measures.
preservedRegressions: Cold combined cost is higher in all six current-vs-baseline paired comparisons. Warm total median is higher for current-common in round 3; p95/p99 regressions in individual rounds are retained in pairedRoundDeltas and all raw samples. No favorable-only reruns were performed.
limitations: Only one static 1920x1080 fully-open row/status fixture; no hidden, animated, hovered, scrolling or varying-status workload
Draw and hit counts are command-model counts, not GPU draw calls or native API costs
Includes normal allocation/GC effects during warm batches; no per-frame allocated-byte API was used
No frame pacing, RPH drawing, text rendering, GameFiber, mouse polling, scene load, GTA frame-time, FPS, GPU use or audibility was measured
Three short fresh-process runs per cohort establish a bounded construction sample, not general performance equivalence
Cold differences include JIT/layout path differences and are not evidence of in-game open-animation hitch duration

failedAttempts.stage: Shell orchestration parse before any measurement
failedAttempts.error: An empty pipe element is not allowed
failedAttempts.effect: PowerShell parsed no commands; zero benchmark processes ran in that failed invocation
